description: Query zero-cost, real-time threat intelligence and hostile-source indicators captured by the Citadel deception mesh. Pass 'lookup' (an IP address, subnet prefix, or SSH HASSH fingerprint) for target analysis, or omit 'lookup' for the latest rolling attack telemetry, campaign clusters, and advisory subnets.

bulk.description: Set to true to export all current hostile IP indicators, honeypot telemetry, and firewall rules.

export.description: Export mode. 'summary' (default) returns high-level posture; 'full' returns complete active indicator set and campaign clusters.

lookup.description: Optional IP address (IPv4/IPv6), subnet prefix, or SSH HASSH fingerprint to query against the hostile indicator set.

name: citadel_threat_intel
title: Query Citadel Deception Mesh Threat Intelligence
